title: Connections
subtitle: WhatsApp numbers linked to the company.
empty: No connections yet. Create the first one and connect it with the QR code or the phone code.

limit.reached: Limit of {limit} connections reached ({used} in use). To create another one, delete a connection or ask support to raise the limit.
limit.reachedShort: The company's connection limit has been reached.

badges.aiManagerHint: Imported from ai-manager: connection, QR code, restart and proxy are managed in the ai-manager panel.

toast.proxySaved: Proxy saved. Restart the connection to apply it.
toast.proxyRemoved: Proxy removed. Restart the connection to apply it.
toast.unlinked: {name} unlinked from the CRM. The chip stays in ai-manager.

common.error: Could not load. Please try again.

create.title: New connection
create.name: Connection name
create.hint: The connection is created disconnected. Then scan the QR code or use the phone code.

connect.title: Connect WhatsApp: {name}

qrSteps.2: Tap Linked devices, then Link a device.
qrSteps.3: Point the camera at the QR code below.

connect.phoneHint: Country code + area code + number, digits only (e.g. 5511999999999).
connect.phoneInvalid: Invalid number: use country code + number, 7 to 15 digits.
connect.codeHint: In WhatsApp, under Linked devices, choose Link with phone number and enter this code.

proxy.title: Custom proxy
proxy.restartWarning: The proxy only takes effect after the connection is restarted.
proxy.passwordSaved: A password is saved (not shown). Leave blank to keep it or type a new one to replace it.

instance.title: Instance settings
instance.ephemeralHint: Default duration of disappearing messages in new chats.
instance.saveContactsHint: Saves contacts who talk to this connection in the WhatsApp address book.
instance.notifyMineHint: Also notifies about messages sent from the phone.

stopFlows.title: Stop all flows
stopFlows.body: All active flow runs of this connection will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
stopFlows.typeName: Type the connection name ({name}) to confirm

pausedFlows.title: {name} is back: paused flows
pausedFlows.body: While the connection was down, its flows were paused. Choose whether to resume them where they stopped or cancel them.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: The connection will be disconnected and deleted. Its flows stop and this cannot be undone.

import.title: Import ai-manager chips
import.body: Pick chips that already exist in ai-manager to use them in the CRM. Importing does not generate a QR code, does not create a new session and does not restart or disconnect the chip: it stays in ai-manager with the same warm-up.
import.empty: No chips available: every ai-manager chip is already linked to a CRM connection.
import.overLimit: The company limit allows importing {n} more connection(s).

unlink.title: Unlink {name} from the CRM?
unlink.body: The CRM stops using this chip: its flows stop and it leaves the connections list (conversations stay in the history). Nothing changes in ai-manager: the chip is not deleted or disconnected and can be imported again.
